pairs.why: The two clocks are nearly identical, but A's blue centre cap and slightly darker shading on the rim sit closer to the real clock's soft finish than B's brighter, more saturated version with its red cap.
This is the same pair as q032 swapped: B is the blue-cap clock with the softer, more shaded orange rim, closer to the real card than A's brighter red-cap version.
B's headphones are plain matte blue like the real card, while A's have glossy cyan cups and chrome rings that look more toy-like; the two decks are otherwise about equal.
This is the same pair as q034 swapped: A has the plain blue headphones that match the real card, while B has the glossy cyan and chrome cups.
A's chest has softer, more painterly wood and a fuller heap of coins, closer to the real chest, while B looks slightly chunkier and more hard-edged.
This is the same pair as q036 swapped: B has the softer painterly wood and the fuller coin heap that read like the real card.
A has a clean, smooth hull and an angled bowsprit like the real ship, while B adds scratch marks on the hull (the 'too texture-y' problem from the lessons) and a knob-shaped figurehead.
This is the same pair as q038 swapped: B has the smooth hull and bowsprit like the real ship, while A has the scratched hull.
